page.overview:
Who is Craig Fäster?

Craig Fäster is a minor character in Cars. He is a rusty monster truck who supports the medicated bumper ointment trademark Rust-eze, as well as the race car it sponsors, Lightning McQueen.

Craig listens to McQueen as he gives a speech inside of the Rust-eze sponsor tent at the Motor Speedway of the South.
